5929-6797-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5929-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4772-5231-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-2113-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-2113-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-3836-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3836-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-2999.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2292-4640-8032--201.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3147-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-7824.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1580-4871-5686-6112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-647-1409-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4742-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2921-6602--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

1157-5638-7070--32.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
1157-5638-7070--32.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
Plate Armor's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.
1157-5638-7070--32.notes: The chosen Eldrazi must be colorless.

252-4871-7296.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-7296.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2034-2604-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ugin, the Ineffable.
Repeat.

2034-2816-3169-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

57-4846-5295-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-5295-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

5344-5849-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
5344-5849-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

1483-2438-6972--112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
1483-2438-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

147-2292-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

918-1640-4083.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble is indestructible.
918-1640-4083.description:
Deal damage to Donna Noble.
Donna Noble and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Donna Noble trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

275-1878-2713-3454-4539.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
275-1878-2713-3454-4539.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Transplant Theorist twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

5231-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
5231-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

478-539-6479--111.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4365-5223.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1202-1737-4853-5315.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

277-880-4862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2527-3143-5686.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1636-2527-3143-5686.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

4693-5478-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4693-5478-5720-5721.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-2034-2053-3862.notablePrerequisites:
Cephalid Looter does not have summoning sickness.
You do not control an Army.
1636-2034-2053-3862.description:
Activate Cephalid Looter by tapping it, causing target opponent to loot.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1072-2144-3729.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
1072-2144-3729.description:
Kill Ondu Spiritdancer.
Myrkul triggers, creating a token copy of Ondu Spiritdancer that is an enchantment.
When the token Ondu Spiridancer enters the battlefield, it and Underworld Coinsmith trigger.
Resolve the Underworld Coinsmith trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ondu Spiritdancer trigger, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 3.

1335-2034-3334.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2034-3334.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5102.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scampering Scorcher, adding {C}{C}.
Scampering Scorcher dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Scampering Scorcher from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Scampering Scorcher enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens and giving Elementals you control haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

507-1591.description:
When an opponent casts a card from their hand, Possibility Storm will exile it.
Teferi only allows opponent to cast spells at sorcery speed, thus forbidding them from playing any spells allowed by Possibility Storm.

690-4658-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-4658-5070.description:
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Angelic Chorus, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

24-3816.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Hallow by paying {W}, preventing all damage dealt by Wheel of Misfortune to you, and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number, and causing you to gain life equal to the number you chose if you chose the largest number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

518-739-5109.notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials's emblem.
518-739-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, targeting any creature.
In response, cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the same creature and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to you, which does not cause you to lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials's emblem.
Arcbond's delayed triggered ability triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to all other creatures and all players, which again does not cause you to lose the game.
